name: Magical Love Lesson
source:
Childhood friend suddenly confesses to main character that she is actually a magical girl. They need to study for the exam, It's easier to memorize something if it's associated with something naughty, so they start special magical training sessions every night.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
青梅竹马突然向主人公坦白她其实是一名魔法少女。他们需要准备考试，而把知识和色色的事情关联起来更容易记忆，于是他们开始了每晚的特别魔法训练课程。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
